title: Zero-round alternating class
statement: The class of binary languages represented by the alternating quantifier construction with zero rounds, for either choice of its initial quantifier, is exactly the class of polynomial-time decidable binary languages $\mathsf{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary Boolean choice of the initial quantifier
